justification: Yes: this package contains 41 Java source files and 7,327 total LOC under `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/output` (including `package-info.java`). The package-info describes it broadly as providing output classes such as `OutputStream` and `Writer`, and the inspected classes show many unrelated responsibilities in one package: delegating/proxy streams (`ProxyOutputStream`, `ProxyWriter`), threshold/file-backed output (`DeferredFileOutputStream`, `ThresholdingOutputStream`, `LockableFileWriter`), adapters between APIs (`WriterOutputStream`, `AppendableWriter`, `AppendableOutputStream`), special-purpose utilities (`XmlStreamWriter`, `QueueOutputStream`, `DemuxOutputStream`), and sentinel wrappers (`NullOutputStream`, `ClosedOutputStream`, `BrokenOutputStream`, `TeeOutputStream`). This breadth and volume indicate a centralized, decomposable God Component.
